Six boxes G, H, I, J, K and L are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. G is kept third from the bottom. Only two boxes are kept between G and H. Only three boxes are kept between H and I. J is kept immediately above G. K is kept immediately below I.

How many boxes are kept between H and L?
